Every figure below is a **build artifact**: `figures/*.json` is the source, the pipeline
(Nextflow, Snakemake or `scripts/verify.sh`) regenerates `out/*.png` with the pinned engine and
verifies the bytes against `figures.manifest.json`, and this document embeds the result. The
same spec is also embedded **live** through the CanvasXpress Quarto shortcode, so the static
figure in the PDF and the interactive figure in the HTML are one artifact, not two.

## Provenance

The engine version and the SHA-256 of every figure are in `figures.manifest.json`; a
regenerated figure whose bytes differ fails the build. Cite the exact engine version you used
(the CanvasXpress Zenodo concept DOI resolves to per-release DOIs).
